meta.title: ENOX – International Energy Consulting
meta.description: Energy consulting with global reach. We guide residential and commercial buildings on the path to climate neutrality.

hero.title: Efficient energy. Future-ready buildings.
hero.subtitle: ENOX supports owners, architects and companies worldwide with energy retrofits, audits and grant-eligible concepts.

services.title: Our services
services.subtitle: Holistic energy consulting for residential, commercial and public buildings – international and aligned with local standards.

residential.title: Residential buildings
residential.description: Energy certificates, individual renovation roadmaps, KfW efficiency house verifications, heating load calculations and refurbishment plans.

commercial.title: Non-residential buildings
commercial.description: Energy audits per DIN EN 16247, BAFA modules, energy management systems and economic feasibility analyses for businesses.

audit.title: Energy audit
audit.description: Mandatory audits under EDL-G for non-SMEs, including measure catalogue and funding advisory.

certificate.title: Energy certificate
certificate.description: Consumption and demand certificates per GEG for owners, administrators and investors – fast and legally compliant.

thermography.title: Thermography
thermography.description: Building thermography to detect thermal bridges, leakages and weak points of the building envelope.

photovoltaic.title: Photovoltaics & storage
photovoltaic.description: Sizing, financial modelling and grant support for PV systems, battery storage and heat pumps.

architecture.title: Architecture & planning
architecture.description: Floor plans, building permits and construction supervision with a clear focus on energy-efficient design.

international.title: International projects
international.description: Consulting in five languages, projects in Europe, Asia and Latin America aligned with the EU taxonomy and ESG criteria.

about.title: About ENOX
about.lead: Founded by Enes Talha Aktürk, ENOX combines German engineering with a global perspective.
about.body: As an independent energy consultancy we accompany owners, investors and companies along the entire value chain of a building – from initial assessment, through the conception of grant-eligible measures, to implementation supervision. Our interdisciplinary team of energy consultants, architects and engineers thinks internationally and works to the standards of the German Energy Agency (dena), KfW and the EU.

founder.title: Owner & founder
founder.name: Enes Talha Aktürk
founder.quote: Energy is the language buildings use to shape the future. Our task is to give every site the right words.

independence.title: Independence
independence.description: We represent only our clients' interests – product- and manufacturer-neutral.

precision.title: Precision
precision.description: Robust calculations, audited methods and transparent documentation.

international.title: International outlook
international.description: Consulting in five languages and project experience across three continents.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.description: Every recommendation follows efficiency before replacement and CO₂ reduction.

career.title: Careers at ENOX
career.subtitle: Join a team that thinks the energy transition internationally.
career.body: We are looking for people ready to take responsibility – as energy consultants, architects, civil engineers or working students. ENOX offers flexible work models, international projects and continuous professional development.
